description:
Terra Invicta Inspired Flag Pack

Also these flags are now part of new and restored Legacy Waving Banners in collaboration with thecno126, check them out!

After revisiting one old idea and having one productive hyperfixation I created this player flag pack. Flag designs are based on sprites from the game Terra Invicta (in game faction's logos and Alien nation).

Pack contains 10 player flags with different aesthetics, bright colors and symbolism.

HUMAN FACTIONS

ALIENS/HYDRA

You didn't know it, you didn't expect it, but I created a new update to celebrate finally getting on Index! 7 new flags and edit to the original Academy Flag, for all of you to enjoy!

INDEX UPDATE (03/11/25)

I did reach out to Pavonis Interactive, but as this pack is based on copyrighted materials it should be distributed only for free, and Pavonis Interactive reserves the right to potentially claim it under copyright laws.

discordPostHtml:
As title says, it is flag pack inspired by Terra Invicta human and alien factions.

Pack in total adds 10 flags with most being expansion on faction themes and aesthetic. Check picture below to see all of them.

Direct download: https://github.com/Vexlia-Artemiss/Starsector-TI-Player-Flags/releases/latest/download/Terra_Invicta_Player_Flags.zip
Forum Post: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=32317
aiDescription: Adds 10 player flags with designs based on sprites from Terra Invicta. The pack includes flags for human factions and aliens/hydra with bright colors and symbolism. A recent update added 7 new flags and edited the original Academy Flag.
